name: 47882 · Sullivan, IN
findings: ZIP 47882 (Sullivan) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47882 (Sullivan) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
